answer: Bindings are kept in hollow, verified in signal, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the dune check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 9 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
